Experiments

Saved setups in this browser

Save a setup to revisit its sound.
Playback always starts stopped.
Play individual tones with Z and /; Space toggles both and Esc stops all. These shortcuts remain active while dragging, editing numbers, or using selectors. Drag pitch sliders or spectrum tone labels to tune; hold Shift for fine adjustment. Drag anywhere inside a column (colored or gray) to shape harmonics (Shift for fine adjustment). Click its surrounding space or index to highlight only; click elsewhere to clear the highlight. Scroll to zoom the spectrum; drag empty space to pan. Click a spectrum line to highlight it, or drag it vertically to tune that tone’s entire harmonic series (Shift for fine adjustment). Harmonic spacing is preserved; frequency limits, snapping, and Fix ratio still apply. Press B to switch channel routing. Mixed output sends both tones to both ears; split output sends one to each ear. Link A/B levels matches both level controls; enabling it copies A’s level to B. Equal RMS does not guarantee equal perceived loudness. Click numerator, denominator, or cents to edit; Enter or leaving the field commits and Escape cancels. Drag the B / A decimal to tune the ratio, holding Shift for fine adjustment. Ratio means B / A; positive cents put B above A. Fix ratio links both pitches within C0–C10. Note labels use twelve-tone equal temperament (A4 = 440 Hz). Snap to harmonic alignment attracts frequency controls to nearby matching nonzero-amplitude harmonics (10 cents to engage, 16 cents to release), with low-order and stronger pairs preferred. Harmonic snapping takes priority over semitone snapping near an alignment and pauses with Fix ratio. Dashed links mark actual harmonic coincidences, even with snapping off; they are not a dissonance score. Drag the divider below the spectrum and Playback panels to resize their shared height. Shift gives fine adjustment; arrow keys work when the divider is focused. By default the panels fit all controls. Shrink the panels to scroll the controls internally, or double-click the divider to fit them again. The height is saved with the record. Use Save (⌘S / Ctrl+S) to save the current setup to its record. Changes are not saved automatically. New (⌘N / Ctrl+N) creates a default setup; unsaved changes prompt before leaving or switching. Rename a record in the title field or with its pencil button. Use the trash button to delete a record; confirmation is required. The latest opened saved record loads on startup, with audio stopped. Audio shortcuts pause while typing a record name.
